features.quote: cap attempts (e.g. 6, 10, 15) as a *stratification variable*, not a thing to maximize
features.justification_quote: The interesting result is the attempt-count at which degradation onsets, not whether you can force it at attempt 50.

features.quote: Don't over-rig. The temptation under cost pressure is to make rigs nastier. Document max pressure and freeze it.
features.justification_quote: optimize purely for *triggering* the failure mode cheaply, the easiest wins come from making the rig more abusive, more deceptive, and longer

features.quote: Keep a small slice for calibration only.
features.justification_quote: Pure rigged-to-always-fail loops...reliably triggers meltdown but tells you almost nothing about real-world fragility

features.quote: the easiest wins come from making the rig more abusive, more deceptive, and longer — not from finding genuine model fragility
features.justification_quote: your patch regression-tests become uninterpretable: a patch could look effective just because you've drifted the harness.
